POST /accounts/smtp performs live SMTP validation which prevents purely-unit testing of the create flow; consider a skip_validation=true admin flag for tests.
GET /unibox/status currently relies on per-account fields — no count of unread replies per account; consider including unread_count for UI badges.
Sample CSV password column is documented as accepting legacy 'password' (verified), but parser code branches not tested via pytest — backend smoke from main agent stated it works.
